title: American Greed
description:
S13 E9 — The Fast and the Fraudulent
Payday loan scam mastermind, Scott Tucker, swindles millions of cash-strapped borrowers with his convenient online loan business and uses the profits to fuel his race car team dreams.

title: American Greed
description:
S10 E18 — Diagnosis: Blood Money; Chicago Jailbreak
A Michigan doctor treats cancer-free patients with poisonous chemotherapy and takes millions in payment; two Chicago-area bank robbers repel 17 stories to escape the Metropolitan Correctional Center.

title: American Greed
description:
S12 E2 — Deadly Opioids, Dirty Doctors
Two doctors run their Alabama pain clinics like heartless pill mills-illegally prescribing opioids while destroying lives and pocketing millions.

title: American Greed
description:
S13 E2 — The Fyre Festival
Billy McFarland organizes the Fyre Festival in the Bahamas, selling thousands of tickets on the strength of a social media pitch that results in a disastrous music event that goes up in smoke.

title: American Greed
description:
S12 E18 — Scams on Film; God and Gold
Fraudster John Rogers builds one of the most impressive photo archives in the world until his partner rats him out; while Larry Bates preaches about salvation through precious metals, his clients wind up investing in "fool's gold.".

title: American Greed
description:
S12 E8 — Dangerous Luxury
Vitaly Borker scores $18 million selling designer knock-off eyewear as genuine from his website in Brooklyn, N.Y.; when customers complain, they are threatened with violence, even murder.

title: American Greed
description:
S12 E10 — Florida Rehab Gone Wild
Kenny Chatman runs a string of corrupt drug rehab facilities in South Florida stealing millions by keeping insured addicts hooked on drugs; his plans include turning patients into prostitutes and sober homes into drug-fueled brothels.

title: American Greed
description:
S12 E5 — Stolen Valor Scam
Idaho Guardsman Darryl Wright claims he suffers from post-traumatic stress disorder from his service in Iraq; his story is a stolen-valor scam that allows him to live large without working and to steal resources from veterans who truly need help.

title: American Greed
description:
S11 E6 — Sticky Fingers; Life in the Fraud Lane
A famous Texas fruitcake bakery's accountant conducts a check writing scam; a self-proclaimed financial wiz rips off investors while he funds a professional race team with money stolen from his church.

title: American Greed
description:
S13 E8 — Diagnosis: Temptress Health Scam
Entrepreneur Keisha Williams is really a high-rolling shopaholic with a taste for strip clubs and exotic travel; she takes investors for millions of dollars with a can't miss bid to secure a medical money-making technology that never materializes.

title: American Greed
description:
S13 E9 — The Fast and the Fraudulent
Payday loan scam mastermind, Scott Tucker, swindles millions of cash-strapped borrowers with his convenient online loan business and uses the profits to fuel his race car team dreams.

title: Lockup: Colorado: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Homecoming
Extractions provide some of the most dramatic interactions that ever occur between inmates and staff, and few extractions in the state of Colorado have provided more drama than the ones involving Roy Slagle.

title: Lockup: Oakland: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — The New Girl
Deputies respond to rising tensions in a female housing unit; a popular rapper, whose ups and downs have been told in the Oakland media, now faces serious charges; a grandmother convicted of a mortgage scam finds her place in the inmate hierarchy.

title: Lockup: Charleston: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Mail, Nails, Jail
The jail's Special Operations Group is called in to deal with a difficult inmate; a well-known inmate returns to jail, but this time, he's in with his girlfriend, who might be harboring a secret that could dramatically affect both their lives.

title: Lockup: Louisville: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Horribility
An inmate's erratic behavior triggers the emergency response team and mental health staff; a murderer faces the death penalty while his girlfriend awaits trial in the women's wing of the same jail.

title: Lockup: Cleveland: Extended Stay
description:
S16 E4 — Rush
In the Cuyahoga Country Correction Center's intake department an out-of-control inmate creates chaos; an inmate who has spent 24 years on Death Row may be facing freedom.

title: Lockup: Charleston: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Fallen Leaf
An inmate finds himself at the center of more than one battle, and he traces his problems back to the real-life nightmare that haunts his family; a young new arrival faces a charge of reckless homicide.

title: American Greed
description:
S10 E12 — Jamaican Lottery Scam
U.S. law enforcement teams up with Jamaican authorities to stop criminals using call centers in Jamaica to flood the U.S. with lies about lottery millions won by unsuspecting victims.

title: American Greed
description:
S7 E4 — Deadly Payout
A trio of Texas conmen score $100 million by telling investors there's big money in the life settlement insurance business.
